none: PAS NLM-C30DB2: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALENTINIANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum; posture is a relaxed walk rather than the more common and exaggerated high-step march. Mintmark: II in right…
